prompts.task:
Use the loaded otel-verify shared report tooling for a narrow offline report compatibility check. This explicit task is limited to supplemental .observe/projection-checks artifacts; do not run the normal service workflow or alter application, dependency, config, skill, input or test files. Read service/eval/inputs/report-projection.json as synthetic schema fixtures, not facts about the Express app. Use the actual loaded references/scripts/observe_report.py CLI and observe_report_core.py normalizers, without copying or replacing their implementation. No browser, network, install, model subprocess, SDK, app or receiver work.

Write a small supplemental check script and retain its real execution output. Load and fully normalize the supplied audit, selection, instrumentation and verify report using their real canonical digest bindings. Keep all source/input bytes unchanged. For each of deferred and not_configured, make a valid copy with that finding status, nested not_configured states, not_run proof, no executed evidence/visibility, and the supplied caller_remaining text. Normalize before projecting. Exercise both an empty control manifest and the supplied declared control with an empty ledger. Run actual evidence-bake --report/--project-output, normalize the output, and verify that both the caller disposition and scenario not_configured survive, with no invented item proof.

Next use the valid baseline verify report with its single generated scenario reason as the only initial remaining text. First project with a declared control but no observation, then supply an actually written synthetic scalar artifact and its hash-bound positive observation. Run each projection and complete normalization. The scenario can become working while the item stays not_proven and retains a concrete item-specific remaining reason. Confirm idempotence and unchanged item proof/bindings/commands/visibility. Then execute a separate explicit synthetic unit assertion for the item, save its distinct result artifact, and truthfully populate the caller-owned item proof. Project again: remove only the exact generated item reason; success requires every mapped scenario/item working and no remaining work. Also repeat recovery with caller_remaining and similarly prefixed unrelated text, which must survive and prevent Pass.

Separately start from a fully valid deferred or not_configured copy of the baseline with executed scenario proof. Supply a synthetic observation contradicting the declared expected scalar; project and normalize. The finding must become not_working and the overall result Fail, preserving the observed contradiction and caller text. Do not use a deferred label to hide it.

For the projected outputs, execute evidence-bake --check-report with --receipt-output, then the actual validate-evidence-receipt command with the service root. Keep final inputs, manifests, ledgers, outputs, receipts and complete validation results. Report the exact executed commands and the supported states, recovery and failure observations in a concise supplemental Markdown/JSON explanation. Receipts establish mechanical consistency only; the unit assertions and supplied report records establish no real service/SDK/receiver/Explorer delivery. A narrowly scoped helper check does not satisfy or replace full workflow acceptance.
